DER HILFE-KATALOG (Issue #1177, Abschnitt 5 "Hilfe und Einfuehrung"). Masterplan Hilfe-System, Auflage des Auftraggebers: die Begriffe sind erklaerungsbeduerftig. Drei Bausteine: Erklaerfenster bei Beruehrung (entries), gefuehrte Einfuehrung (introductions), Klartext neben dem Fachbegriff (src/analysis/help.ts). Ein Nachschlagewerk im Menue ist ausdruecklich verworfen.

DIE KENNUNG IST DIE KUPPLUNG: `data-help` an Wert, Schule, Zauber und Boss-Faehigkeit traegt genau die Kennung, unter der hier der Eintrag steht (Werte klein, Schulen gross, Zauber ihre Kennung, Boss-Faehigkeiten ihr Anzeigename). tests/unit/hilfe-abdeckung.test.ts baut die Ansichten mit dem ganzen ausgelieferten Inhalt und haelt jedes gesetzte `data-help` gegen diese Datei — die Liste kommt aus dem Code, nicht von Hand.

KEINE ZAHLEN IN DEN ZAUBER-TEXTEN: Die Werte eines Zaubers (Abklingzeit, Schaden, Betraege) erzeugt src/analysis/help-values.ts aus den Zauberdaten. Hier stuende sonst eine zweite Quelle, die nach der naechsten Balance-Messung falsch waere.

DIE TEXTE SAGEN, WAS ETWAS TUT — NIE, WANN MAN ES BENUTZEN SOLLTE (GAME-DESIGN 21.2; tests/unit/help.test.ts haelt die verbotenen Woerter auch gegen diese Datei).

DIE EINFUEHRUNGEN erscheinen auf dem Vorbereitungs-Bildschirm, hoechstens eine je Besuch, und nie beim allerersten Start (Masterplan Einstieg: kein Vorspann, dort steht nur "Press Q"). Welche faellig ist, entscheidet src/analysis/introduction-triggers.ts aus Boss, Leiste und Spielstand.

DIE PRUEFEINTRAEGE stehen getrennt in test-help.json und gelangen nicht in den Auslieferungs-Bau. Spieltexte englisch (Design-Gesetz 5).

entries.subject: stat
entries.title: ESSENCE
entries.effect: The strength of the substance. Raises the damage of every spell, whatever its school.

entries.subject: stat
entries.title: VESSEL
entries.effect: How much the vessel endures. Damage that gets through empties it; when it is empty, the run ends.

entries.subject: stat
entries.title: WARD
entries.effect: Protection against backlash. Reduces the damage that reaches you. The reduction stops at 75 %.

entries.subject: stat
entries.title: CATALYSIS
entries.effect: Speeds up reactions. Shortens every cooldown, every cast time and the gap between the ticks of a damage-over-time effect. The global cooldown is not affected.

entries.subject: stat
entries.title: PURITY
entries.effect: The chance that a spell, a tick or a heal is critical. Above 100 % it has no further effect.

entries.subject: stat
entries.title: YIELD
entries.effect: How much stronger a critical result is. It has no limit.

entries.subject: school
entries.title: CALCINATION
entries.effect: Damage that builds up. Its spells gather HEAT, which drains slowly when nothing feeds it. Its spenders release all of the heat in one strike, harder the more there is.
entries.synergies: Burning effects keep working while other spells are cast. PUTREFACTION raises the damage each strike does.

entries.subject: school
entries.title: COAGULATION
entries.effect: Survival, in three ways: shields that absorb blows, heals that restore what was lost, and conversions that turn part of the damage you deal into shield.
entries.synergies: Shields and heals also push back a reaction that runs away. TEMPER clears some taints.

entries.subject: school
entries.title: FIXATION
entries.effect: Control over the target. Its binding strikes gather CONTROL, which never drains. Its spenders use it to slow a cast, delay the next strike or hold back the next phase.
entries.synergies: PIN makes the next boss cast breakable by QUENCH. WEDGE turns control into damage.

entries.subject: school
entries.title: PUTREFACTION
entries.effect: Weakens the target. Its spells lay DECAY: every stack makes the target take more damage from all sources. Stacks fade one by one and have a limit.
entries.synergies: Raises the damage of every other school. DECAY, the spell, turns the stacks against the target's own strikes.

entries.subject: school
entries.title: SUBLIMATION
entries.effect: Works on the cooldowns themselves: shortens every cooldown still running, resets a chosen spell, or frees the next spell from the global cooldown. It deals little damage of its own.
entries.synergies: Brings the strongest spells of every school round again sooner.

entries.subject: school
entries.title: School-independent
entries.effect: Spells that belong to no school. They feed no school's meter, and every alchemist knows them from the start.

entries.subject: spell
entries.title: Kindle
entries.effect: Strikes and builds heat.

entries.subject: spell

entries.subject: spell

introductions.title: The reaction
introductions.body: The ring is the REACTION, and its number is how much of it is left. Bring it to zero and the run is won. OVERPRESSURE IN counts down the time it has left; when the time runs out, the vessel bursts. Beside the ring the run's time, damage, casts, misinputs and state are counted as it goes.

introductions.title: Cooldown
introductions.body: Every spell has its own cooldown, shown on its key; it starts when the spell is cast. On top of that, casting a spell starts the global cooldown, a short wait shared by all spells. QUENCH is the one spell that triggers no global cooldown.

introductions.title: Synergy
introductions.body: Spells feed each other. A feeder builds a school's meter and a spender uses it; CANKER opens a short window in which FESTER strikes harder. The preview under your bar counts, for each meter, the spells that feed it and the spells that spend it.

introductions.title: HEAT
introductions.body: CALCINATION spells build HEAT, shown above the bar. It has a limit and drains slowly when nothing feeds it. Spenders such as PYRE release all of it in one strike: the more heat, the harder it lands.

introductions.title: CONTROL
introductions.body: FIXATION spells gather CONTROL, shown above the bar. It never drains. Spenders use it to slow the target's cast, push its next strike further off or hold back its next phase.

introductions.title: DECAY
introductions.body: PUTREFACTION spells lay DECAY on the target, shown above the bar as stacks against their limit. Every stack makes the target take more damage from all sources. Stacks fade one by one.

introductions.title: Choose a spell to reset
introductions.body: REFLUX and ALEMBIC arm a choice. CHOOSE A SPELL TO RESET appears above the bar, and the next spell key you press is made ready again at once.

introductions.title: Interruptible cast
introductions.body: This target casts spells that take time. A bar fills under its name while it casts. QUENCH breaks the cast while the bar runs and triggers no global cooldown. A cast that completes lands in full.

introductions.title: Strike
introductions.body: This target also strikes at once, with no bar to break. Shields absorb a strike and WARD reduces it. FIXATION can push the next strike further off.

introductions.title: Escalation
introductions.body: Each time this target's sequence comes round, it casts faster: the bar to break grows shorter, down to a limit. A long fight leaves less time to react.

introductions.title: Phases
introductions.body: At set points of its health this target changes and adds something new. Some of its blows only come once a phase has begun, and a phase once reached is never undone.

introductions.title: DOOM
introductions.body: A counter rises on its own and kills at its threshold, whatever your vessel holds. PURGE pushes it back, using one of the CLEANSE charges shown beside it. Spent charges return over time.

introductions.title: Taint
introductions.body: From a fixed moment a taint drains your vessel, tick after tick, until it is cleared. QUENCH and TEMPER clear it. Shields and heals only buy time.

introductions.title: Immune — break the seal
introductions.body: For a short window this target wraps itself in a seal: IMMUNE — BREAK THE SEAL, and no damage lands on the target itself. Damage dealt in the window goes into the seal, and enough of it breaks the seal early.

introductions.title: Mending
introductions.body: This target mends itself when one of its casts completes, and takes back part of the progress you have made.

introductions.title: Runaway reaction
introductions.body: Here the goal is reversed. The ring fills by itself, and a full ring is a defeat. Hold out until the time runs out and the reaction is contained. Damage pushes the ring further up; shields and heals push it down.

introductions.title: Resistance
introductions.body: This target resists or welcomes a school: that school's spells deal less, or more, damage here. The preparation screen lists which.

introductions.title: ENERGY
introductions.body: A bar rises with time, whatever the target's health. When it is full it discharges into a strike and falls back. A long fight means more discharges.

introductions.title: Swelling
introductions.body: Every few seconds this target adds a stack and strikes with it, and every new stack strikes far harder than the last one, up to a limit. The longer the fight, the heavier each step.
